standard_prerequisites: The category WAdm^{Noeth} of adic Noetherian topological rings with continuous morphisms, and the local-property criterion of Formal Spaces for arrows
The completed naive cotangent complex with its functorial exact sequence, as developed in the same chapter
Base change and descent behaviour of the Ext annihilation characterizing rig-smoothness, from More on Algebra
core_obligations: Preliminary identification: for etale A to A' and B to B' the completed cotangent complexes of the completions vanish, and NL of (B')^wedge over (A')^wedge is the base change of NL of B over A
Condition (1): the Ext annihilation bound transport forward under base change by B to (B')^wedge
Condition (2): faithful flatness of B to B' descends the annihilation bound through the base change identity for Ext
Condition (3): additivity of the completed cotangent complex under finite products
proof_roadmap: Set up the commutative square of adic Noetherian rings and the three conditions to verify
Derive the two quasi-isomorphisms giving the base-change identification of the completed cotangent complexes
Prove (1) by transporting the annihilation exponent, and (2) by faithful flatness descent via the cited base change identity
Prove (3) by the direct sum decomposition of the cotangent complex
difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is that rig-smooth is a local property of arrows in WAdm^{Noeth} (source lines 4252-4368, label lemma-rig-smooth-axioms). The solver must first assemble the base-change identification of the completed naive cotangent complexes from two quasi-isomorphisms, then transport an Ext-annihilation bound forward under base change and backward under faithful flatness; the descent direction with its Ext base-change identity is the substantive step. Allowed background: the chapter's completed NL machinery and the cited More on Algebra and Formal Spaces lemmas, delivered as navigation pointers.
